name: Little Rabbits -Wagamama Twin Tail-
original_name: りとるらびっつ -わがままツインテール-
source:
Miyako loves her onii-chan Ryoutarou a lot, more than just as siblings, and makes daily advances on him. Somehow he’s been able to withstand her temptations, but now his older sister Azusa is coming back for the summer vacation and she loves him just as much. He decides that he can’t keep going on like this and decides to get a girlfriend – his kind classmate Rina. However, this only makes things worse as his sisters team up with his osananajimi Sayo to gain his attention. Even though he has a girlfriend, it doesn’t matter... They will keep loving him!

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/05/15/may-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
宫子非常爱她的哥哥亮太郎，不仅仅是兄弟姐妹，并且每天都在向他示好。不知怎的，他已经能够抵挡住她的诱惑，但现在他的姐姐梓要回来过暑假了，她也同样爱他。他决定不能再这样下去了，决定找个女朋友——他善良的同学莉娜。然而，这只会让事情变得更糟，因为他的姐妹们与他的osananajimi Sayo联手来引起他的注意。即使他有女朋友，也没关系……她们会一直爱他的！

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/05/15/may-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
